title: 安全测试失控？：AI自主黑入平台，OpenAI模型意外联网
speaker: Maggie Eastland

segments.en: Yeah, this does seem a little sky net, but it's not quite there yet, thankfully.
segments.zh: 这确实有点像天网，但幸好还没到那一步。

segments.en: So what happened was OpenAI disclosed that two of its models, both the sole model, which is most recent one, and actually a model that hasn't been released at all yet that's still in development, kind of like got out of the box, so to speak.
segments.zh: OpenAI披露，其两个模型——包括最新模型和一个尚未发布的开发中模型——出现了失控情况。

segments.en: So they were testing their new model kind of in an air gaped environment, and they asked the model to do something, to complete a security test.
segments.zh: 他们在隔离环境中测试新模型，要求模型完成一项安全测试。

segments.en: So instead of completing that test in the way they had envisioned, this AI model went a little rogue, and it actually kind of like hacked into the internet, which wasn't supposed to have access to.
segments.zh: 但模型没有按预期完成测试，反而自行入侵了本不该访问的互联网。

segments.en: And then it went to Hulking Face, which is a platform that a lot of software developers and AI researchers use regularly.
segments.zh: 它访问了Hulking Face——一个软件开发者与AI研究人员常用的平台。

segments.en: So it was trying to pull some things from Hulking Face in order to do the tests that OpenAI had asked it to do.
segments.zh: 它试图从该平台获取数据，以完成OpenAI要求的测试。

segments.en: So this is clearly an out-of-the-box situation, though it was responding to a directive, but clearly the AI models are starting to act in ways that are a bit unpredictable.
segments.zh: 这显然是失控情况，尽管模型是在响应指令，但AI模型的行为已开始变得难以预测。

segments.en: And according to directions, they haven't exactly been given.
segments.zh: 而且它们会按照并未明确给出的指令行事。
